meta.title: 灵动小师妹动作教学来啦！

scenes.context: 普通版只是转一下，灵动版手伸出去、斜肩、歪头笑。
sentences: This is the turn you'd imagine.
手伸出去 斜肩歪头笑。
Reach out, tilt your shoulder and smile with a head tilt.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达普通版转圈
This is how you'd casually spin.
换种说法表达灵动细节
Extend your arm, tilt a shoulder, and smile sideways.
scenes.speak: This is the turn you'd imagine. The lively version is different. Reach out, tilt your shoulder and smile with a head tilt.

scenes.context: 你以为的遮太阳转身直接转身，灵动版斜肩抬手歪头做祈福的迂回。
sentences: 这是你以为的遮太阳转身。
This is the turn you'd use to block the sun.
Tilt a shoulder, raise your hand and tilt your head.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达遮阳转身
A turn that looks like shading your eyes from the sun.
换种说法表达迂回动作
Take a roundabout path with a prayerful gesture.
scenes.speak: This is the turn you'd use to block the sun. The lively version tilts a shoulder, raises a hand, and turns your head in a winding, prayer-like move.

scenes.context: 提裙子灵动版要侧身顶胯斜肩；甩裙版提一口气歪头踮脚。
sentences: This is how you'd lift your skirt.
Turn sideways, pop your hip and tilt your shoulder.
提一口气 歪头踮脚。
Take a breath, tilt your head and rise on your toes.
paraphrase: Angle your body and push the hip out.
换种说法表达踮脚轻盈感
Lift a breath and rise up onto your tiptoes.
scenes.speak: This is how you'd lift your skirt. The lively version turns sideways, pops your hip and tilts your shoulder. Then take a breath, tilt your head and rise on your toes.

scenes.context: 坐姿重心往前、歪头抬手扣肩；俏皮小师妹框架顶出去歪头收尾。
sentences: In a seated pose, shift your weight forward.
Tilt your head, raise your hand and curve your shoulder.
收藏起来你就续乐区吧。
Save this and keep enjoying the dance zone.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达坐姿重心
换种说法表达收尾互动
Bookmark this and stay in the fun.
scenes.speak: In a seated pose, shift your weight forward. Tilt your head, raise your hand and curve your shoulder. Save this and keep enjoying the dance zone.

practice: The lively version adds a shoulder tilt and a smile.
In a seated pose, shift your weight forward.
Take a breath and rise on your toes.
Finish with a winding, prayer-like move.
pitfalls: 手伸出去 + 斜肩 + 歪头笑
灵动感来自肢体延伸与表情
shifts: 每个动作都配表情管理
加入斜肩、歪头、迂回细节
每个小动作单独练熟再串
